picks.title: Introducing Runway App Studio
picks.excerpt: Build custom AI apps that generate images, video and audio with your Brand Kits and Workflows. No code required, and easy to share with your whole team.
picks.rationale: A new Runway product that lets a team wrap its own Workflows and Brand Kits into no-code image, video and audio apps it can share. It is a primary-source release from the past day and changes how a studio packages its generation pipeline.

picks.title: China’s First AI Feature Flops At The Chinese Box Office
picks.excerpt: Bona Film Group’s AI experiment struggled to attract attention, months after the humble 'Niu Lai’ turned online ridicule into almost $10 million in sales.
picks.rationale: Follow-up with new data. The 10-23 card covered the opening announcement, and this one reports the box-office result: Bona's fully AI-generated feature flopped, which is the first real audience verdict on an AI theatrical release.

picks.title: This Hack Fixes Your AI Character Consistency Issues (Pro Workflow)
picks.excerpt: In this video, we'll compare two popular AI character consistency methods to see which one actually works better for AI filmmaking.Check out the full written...
picks.rationale: A practical side-by-side test of two character-consistency methods for AI filmmaking. It is the most actionable craft item in the pool, and the 30-day history has no card on character consistency.

picks.title: Ramayana: Producer Namit Malhotra Explains How Human Voices Combined With AI Formed English Dubbing
picks.excerpt: Ramayana Part 1 was shot only in Hindi. Its English and other international versions use Brahma AI, which combines the human actors' voice work with AI audio and lip-sync so each language version matches the actors' mouth movements. The film opens in theatres and IMAX on November 5.
picks.rationale: A concrete production decision on a major theatrical release. 'Ramayana Part 1' was shot only in Hindi, and its English and international versions use Brahma AI to blend the actors' own voice work with AI audio and lip-sync ahead of the 11-05 theatrical and IMAX opening.
